assertions.description: margin-trim: inline is accepted, for containers laying children out in the inline direction.
The single-edge values block-start, block-end, inline-start and inline-end are all accepted.
The initial value is none, so adding the property to a stylesheet cannot change a container that does not opt in.

On a block container, margin-trim: block must remove the first child's block-start margin and the last child's block-end margin, measured from the rendered boxes. This is the behaviour, not just the parse.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(!CSS.supports('margin-trim','block'))return false;const box=document.createElement('div');box.style.cssText='position:absolute;visibility:hidden;padding:20px;margin-trim:block;width:200px';for(let n=0;n<3;n++){const kid=document.createElement('div');kid.style.cssText='margin-block:16px;height:10px';box.append(kid);}document.body.append(box);const kids=[...box.children];const br=box.getBoundingClientRect();const cs=getComputedStyle(box);const top=Math.round(kids[0].getBoundingClientRect().top-(br.top+parseFloat(cs.paddingTop)));const bottom=Math.round((br.bottom-parseFloat(cs.paddingBottom))-kids[2].getBoundingClientRect().bottom);box.remove();return top===0&&bottom===0;})()

assertions.description: Trimming must affect only the margins that meet the container's edge. The gap between two adjacent children must be unchanged, or the property would be collapsing the layout rather than trimming it.
A single-edge value must trim only that edge: with block-start the trailing margin survives.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(!CSS.supports('margin-trim','block-start'))return false;const box=document.createElement('div');box.style.cssText='position:absolute;visibility:hidden;padding:20px;margin-trim:block-start;width:200px';for(let n=0;n<3;n++){const kid=document.createElement('div');kid.style.cssText='margin-block:16px;height:10px';box.append(kid);}document.body.append(box);const kids=[...box.children];const br=box.getBoundingClientRect();const cs=getComputedStyle(box);const top=Math.round(kids[0].getBoundingClientRect().top-(br.top+parseFloat(cs.paddingTop)));const bottom=Math.round((br.bottom-parseFloat(cs.paddingBottom))-kids[2].getBoundingClientRect().bottom);box.remove();return top===0&&bottom===16;})()
